PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(java|ts|tsx)$"); do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *api.ts|*generated*) continue;; esac; if ! grep -qE "/\*\*|^//|/\*[^*]" "$f"; then echo "DOC_WARNING: $f has no documentation comments"; fi; done; exit 0'
